column1: # tests/mutants/accumulate.tsv — single-clause mutants of tools/self/accumulate.sh (dir #838 slice 1a, spec A13).
# keel-self-maintenance: read by tools/self/mutation-sweep.sh (swept against tests/test_accumulate.sh) and checked for
# staleness by tests/test_mutation_lists.sh. Rows 1-10 are the spec's ten; the rest are this tool's own.
# Columns, TAB-separated: id, file, needle, replacement, note. The needle must occur exactly once in the file.

column5: A13 1: the window edge — a 60-day-old sighting must not count
A13 2: add rejects a date after --as-of
A13 3: count distinct sources, not rows (/go + /polish on one source)
A13 4: due at exactly the threshold
A13 5: danger needs felt yes
A13 6: after fixed only later sightings count
A13 7: retire never touches a promoted class
A13 8: the per-class window column
A13 9: closed reads KB.N / B.N headings
A13 10: a lock older than 2 hours is broken
a duplicate (class, source, consumer) is a no-op
counts felt filters unfelt sightings
due --owner filters
a sighting dated on the closure day is not after it
a promoted class is never due
a new sighting reopens a retired class
closed ignores a foreign ticket's citation
a tag line inside a code fence does not count
the tag must start its own line
seen-again needs a sighting dated after the promotion
verdict looks only at the consumer's own classes
a promotion whose ticket closed is not NEEDS-REWORK
lint: duplicate (class, source, consumer)
lint: unknown class
lint: sighting date
lint: class status
lint: missing owner
isdate: Feb 29 of a leap year
dn: the March-based month offset across a leap day
add: felt is yes or no
init never overwrites
set_status rewrites only the named row
a write under the caller's lock proceeds
a write that took its own lock releases it
